item.title: Java 8 Overview: The Most Important Java Release Ever
item.description: Why Java 8 Matters A decade after its release, Java 8 remains one of the most widely deployed Java versions in enterprise production. That longevity is not inertia — it reflects how much the release changed what idiomatic Java looks like. Understanding Java 8 is not just about learning historical features; it is the foundation for every Java release that followed. Java 8 was released on 18 March 2014 — nearly three years after Java 7 — and it changed Java more fundamentally than any release before or since.
